knownGaps: Human calibration annotation (EXPECTED | INCORRECT | UNCLEAR) on the observed Phoenix traces has not yet been recorded; B0 names it required, so verificationState stays PARTIAL until a human inspects the traces.

The seeded trust/history rows on news:reuters.com were written via the SurrealDB operator path because learned-train lanes require a real LLM key (only a format-valid placeholder was used and is never called by the /v1/sources read path); the positive case therefore exercises declared-authority + scoped-trust mapping against operator-seeded rows, not organically learned reputation.

An earlier exploratory positive run (traceId 4c6fbe2bd946f22562d7d5ef823bb673, domainHint=finance) exercised the absent-scoped-trust path (8/9 UNKNOWN); the canonical record cites the corrected news_reporting run above.
This record was authored from observed runs by the orchestrator; it does not re-execute them.
No client integration (B1/B2), benchmark, or holdout (Gate C) evidence exists.
proves: A real (non-stub) INITE Brain service, self-hosted from inite-ai/inite-brain-service@3a33d2239bbc0fbb932f3bdff042644899e225d9, answered the exact adapter-contract route GET /v1/sources/{sourceKey} with shapes the adapter's zod boundary parses unchanged.

The chain real source -> source-ranker -> INITE Brain -> SourceAssessment -> OTel -> Phoenix ran end-to-end: source.assess traces (positive 200 with authorityToClaim+transparency ADEQUATE from seeded scoped trust, failure 404) were inspected in Phoenix carrying decision identity (owningLayer=1, scope=source-suitability, policyId=layer1-source-suitability, authority=AUTHORITATIVE), UNKNOWN dimensions, failures/reasons, policy/evaluator version b0-live-runtime, and W3C PROV activity/entity refs.
Failure-mode honesty held live: unknown source -> BRAIN_SOURCE_UNKNOWN + ABSTAIN; missing env -> fail-fast exit 1; in no observed mode did the provisional backend emit ACCEPT.
